creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`cmd+plus` and `cmd+minus` are reflexes in every terminal and Muster has neither. `config.font_size = 0` inherits the configured size once at surface creation (`Renderer.swift`), so the only way to change it is to edit a config and relaunch.

Worth noting this is a Muster *action* rather than an appearance setting, so it is wanted whatever happens to the appearance loan (see the appearance card): it joins `Action::ALL`, becomes rebindable and gets a menu item, like every other action.

Two things to work out: whether the size is per-window or per-pane (Ghostty does per-surface), and whether a changed size is remembered - it is presentation state, so `[window]` in the state file is the obvious home now that one exists.
title: 🔍 Font size is fixed for the life of a launch
